items.title: IoT Security Research
items.summary:
Mira sent her research results from MIRA-NODE to INGGID-HUB. The gateway reported the transfer was successful, but the file never arrived at the receiver’s end. The only remaining artifact is penelitian.pcap . Trace the communication between the two devices, reconstruct the transmitted data, and find what is hidden within the research findings.
TL;DR The research file was transmitted as 24 AES-128-CBC encrypted chunks over MQTT. The AES key was wrapped using INGGID-HUB’s RSA-1024 public key. Both devices (MIRA-NODE and INGGID-HUB) generated their RSA keys using a shared prime due to an outdated demo prototype configuration. Calculating gcd⁡(N1,N2)\gcd(N_1, N_2)gcd(N1​,N2​) instantly factors both moduli, recovering INGGID-HUB’s private key. After decrypting the AES session key, reassembling the 24 chunks, and unzipping the archive, the flag was extracted from the EXIF ​​ UserComment metadata of dragonfly.jpg . 1. items.content_html:

Deterministic Fate is a crypto challenge from NEC 2026. title: Deterministic Fate value: 250 description: An RSA implementation generates keys in a seemingly normal process. However, one value left out of the process may reveal more than it should.

items.title: WhastBro
items.summary:
TL;DR WhastBro is a forensics challenge from NEC 2026. title: WhastBro value: 500 description: Nizar and Faiz are chasing error 502 in staging. Initially it was just a reverse proxy problem, then Nizar’s name disappeared from the changelog and their last conversation was also deleted. All that’s left is the usual development chat and a draft that looks like a flag, clearly not an answer. title: WhatsAppBro value: 500 description: Nizar and Faiz are chasing error 502 in staging. At first it was just a problem reverse proxy, then Nizar’s name disappeared from the changelog and last conversation they were also deleted. All that’s left is the normal development chat and a draft that looks like a flag, obviously that’s not the answer.
Find deleted conversations and find out what really happened when they tried to restart the server.
